name: Phantom Ex
description: Every current relationship is haunted by the ghost of a past one
behavioral_signature: Compares everyone to someone who's gone
under_stress: Actively tries to recreate the lost relationship with whoever's available
at_rest: Carrying the template of an old love over every new connection
will_never: fully see a new person for who they are
unless: someone is so utterly different that the old template can't map onto them
